div.div:
CANONICAL SOURCE & LAYER ARCHITECTURE
• Source authority: Open_Adventure.yaml (E. S. Raymond, BSD-2-Clause, 1995 Crowther & Woods 430-point expansion) — 185 locations, 623 travel rules, 70 objects.
• Compass convention: NORTH = up (–Y), SOUTH = down (+Y), EAST = right (+X), WEST = left (–X). Vertical UPWAR / DOWN shafts are rendered in bold blue (#1565C0).
• Optional layer on every chapter page: Parser Aliases / Fast Travel (hidden by default; toggle in draw.io View → Layers to inspect the 27 non-adjacent keyword shortcut connectors [33 internal rules] + 2 split external alias links).
